Angel! The Empire's invasion has begun in earnest!{wait}{clear}I think it will affect many countries and regions of the world, so please keep a close eye on changes in the chaos level!

Angel! The Empire is invading toward the heart of the Six Kingdoms.{wait}{clear}Besides the Six Kingdoms, the frontier and other countries bordering the Empire are being invaded one after another.{wait}{clear}Please be careful, the heroes and you too, Angel!

Angel! The Empire has finally invaded even the untamed lands!{wait}{clear}If it keeps up like this, how far will the Empire spread its territory...?{wait}{clear}Please ask the heroes to keep the damage from growing somehow.

Angel! The Empire invaded Alkmaar in Basel and destroyed the Grand Lodge, the heart of the Guild.{wait}{clear}I think this is a very serious problem for the countries of Arcaya.{wait}{clear}It also seems the Empire took something very important.{wait}{clear}Stopping the Empire's invasion may be hard even for the heroes, but please make sure the chaos level doesn't rise!

Angel! St. Diana, the Holy Mother of the Reyforia Forest, was attacked by a boy with a magical beast!{wait}{clear}And it seems Cecia-sama, who's also one of your heroes, Angel, has carried on her wishes and become the Holy Mother.

Angel... The heroes fought hard, but the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia has fallen to the Empire.{wait}{clear}The city was destroyed, and the cathedral was set on fire... Many people died, but it seems some managed to escape.{wait}{clear}Angel... what's going to become of Arcaya now...? Please be very careful too, Angel.
Angel! Hugues Zeint, the king of the Kingdom of Legrance, has passed away.{wait}{clear}Well, the rumor is that somebody assassinated him...

Angel! The Empire has invaded all the way to Legrance.{wait}{clear}And it seems there are demons in the imperial army, so I'm sure they're using the Demon Stone's power.{wait}{clear}I think the fighting will get harder, but hang in there, Angel. I'll do my best too!
Angel! Ion, the boy who stole the Demon Stone from the Forest of the Holy Mother, has died.{wait}{clear}It seems Serenis, the Empire's witch, was using the strong magic power he had.
Angel! Savio, the leader of Legrance's band of assassins, has died.{wait}{clear}It seems Serenis, the Empire's witch, was using his grudge against the nobles.

Angel!! The Heavenly Dragon has finally been revived.{wait}{clear}The Heavenly Dragon is the incarnation of Satan's soul, and it's swallowing up towns and people one after another!!{wait}{clear}The end of the world is only a matter of time! Angel, join forces with the heroes and protect Arcaya!!

Angel! A hero defeated Clarence, the one called Viper, who stole the Demon Stone from the Holy Nation of Ecclesia!{wait}{clear}It seems he couldn't find any hope in this world, so he sided with the Empire...
Angel! A hero defeated Alberic, the imperial knight!{wait}{clear}It seems he craved things others recognize, like honor, and a devil used that feeling... In the end, the demon sword took him over.
Angel! A hero defeated Ravenruft, the vampire king!{wait}{clear}It seems he was a hero who was drenched in the Heavenly Dragon's blood in the battle against it a thousand years ago...
Angel! A hero defeated Ravenruft, the vampire king!{wait}{clear}Now I think people on the frontier will hardly ever be attacked by the undead.
